# NOAH Edge Magazine
# https://noah-edge.com

> NOAH Edge Magazine publishes prediction market intelligence, pharma/litigation tips,
> and curated editorial content. We operate the Noah Poly Index — a tracked, transparent
> prediction market edge tracker with published positions and outcomes.

## What This Site Contains

- **Noah Poly Index**: Live prediction market edge tracking with directional accuracy,
  P&L, and full position disclosure. We enter, we track, we publish.
- **Prediction Intelligence**: Bionic Ear reports scanning Polymarket for mispriced
  contracts. Each report grades candidates A-E by evidence depth.
- **Tips Desk**: Pharma and litigation intelligence from our Information Asymmetry
  signal engine. Early signals before mainstream analyst coverage.
- **The Wire**: Curated editorial stories on prediction markets, regulation,
  and market structure.
- **Scoreboard**: Full transparent record of every position entered, tracked, exited.

## Publisher
Ivan Massow / Noah Wire

## Important Notes
- Nothing on this site constitutes financial advice.
- We actively trade on positions discussed.
- All edges shown reflect our own analysis and activity.
- We disclose positions where indicated.
